verdict.summary: Use one Meta app with compatible Facebook Login and Marketing API use cases, connected to a business portfolio that has completed Business Verification. A multi-tenant agent needs Full Access approval for the applicable permissions/features before outside advertisers can authorize their own assets. Limited Access is automatic but is development-only and is not suitable for live advertisers.
verdict.activeEffort: 2 days–5 days (sum of the step estimates below). No supported aggregate estimate is available; the guide lists separate implementation, testing, and submission-preparation tasks.
verdict.waitTime: Business Verification timing is unstated. Permission review is generally 3 business days, with some permissions taking up to 7 business days; Meta warns some reviews can take several weeks during process or volume changes.
verdict.mainGate: Business Verification, per-permission/feature App Review for Full Access, and Full Access operational qualification before relying on its production capacity.

recommendation.text: Create one app with compatible Marketing API and Facebook Login use cases, connect it to the developer's verified business portfolio, and have every advertiser authorize their own assets through OAuth. Start the agent read-only where possible, keep write authority separate, and require human confirmation for any spend-changing action.

steps.title: Create the Meta app and select compatible use cases

detail.text: In the app-creation console, enter the app name and contact email, then add compatible Marketing API and Facebook Login use cases to the same app. This establishes the single integration that will serve multiple advertiser tenants.

sources.quote: Navigate to **[https://developers.facebook.com/apps/creation/](https://developers.facebook.com/apps/creation/)** to begin the app creation process.
You can add multiple use cases to a single app, provided they are compatible with each other.

detail.text: In the app dashboard, connect the app to the business portfolio that will own this multi-tenant integration. Use a business administrator for the later verification workflow because an app administrator alone cannot complete it.

sources.quote: If your app will access data that you don’t own or manage, you must connect your app to a business portfolio.
Note that anyone with an Administrator role on your app can connect it to a Business, but only someone with an Admin role in the Business will be able to complete the verification process.

detail.text: Use this callback-handler draft as the implementation baseline: consume a short-lived server-side state record, bind it to the initiating user and tenant, exchange the code only on the server, inspect token ownership, and encrypt the tenant-scoped token.

onCallback(q):
  tx = loadAndConsumeState(q.state)
  assert tx && tx.userId == session.userId
  assert q.redirect_uri == CONFIG.REDIRECT_URI
  tokens = exchangeCodeServerSide(q.code, CONFIG.REDIRECT_URI)
  info = debugToken(tokens.access_token)
  assert info.app_id == CONFIG.APP_ID && info.user_id
  saveEncrypted(tx.tenantId, info.user_id, tokens)
